definition: the one constant in the shared food, and what I do with it at each end

settled:
The shared food changes constantly, with one thing that never does: there is always sugar.

Jen feels safe having options in the house, sugar among them, though she rarely eats them and a lot of it gets thrown away. The availability itself is what does her good, so it is protected by the relationship and cannot be taken out.

When I am desperate the best I manage is whichever sugar will be least missed, a soft cheese for the protein, and water.

When I am doing well, food is something I stim on: ice cream, popcorn, fruit. What I worked out for myself is a layer of ice cream over a heaped bowl of pre-cut fruit, which is better than just ice cream.

title: The Sugar That Is Always In The House
